notes:
- Product: VS Code copilot extension (inline completions + streaming completions).
- Primary ask: <100ms perceived inline latency, streaming delta updates for long completions, stable model pinning for reproducible suggestions.
- Quote from CTO: "we need a deterministic dev experience across releases — model pin + rollout control is non-negotiable".
- Auth: per-installation API keys today; want token scoping for per-user quotas + short-lived tokens for extensions. Interested in PKCE / OAuth exchange flow for extension install.
- Rate limits: need per-seat throttles and burst buckets for CI/editor automation use (users trigger mass refactoring jobs). Concerned about global 429s.
- Fallbacks: want automatic fallback to cheaper model variant on overload with preserved shape of completions (no broken formatting).
- Observability: require per-route latency percentiles, streaming error counts, token-level cost breakdown for feature flags (free vs paid tiers).
- Security: SOC2 + SSO for enterprise customers; prefer KMS-backed encryption for cached completions.
- Billing: cost-sensitive — free tier must be low-cost; willing to pay for Dedicated for customer-facing enterprise installs.
- Integration notes: extension uses WebSocket for streaming; asked whether Redwood supports SSE and websocket with keepalive and reconnect semantics.
- POC objective: measure tail latency (95/99) on dev machines across regions, validate per-user token scoping and model pin semantics, quantify per-token cost with automatic KV caching on common prefixes.
- Misc: asked for sample SDK for VS Code (TypeScript) showing streaming handlers + reconnect + chunk reassembly.
- Sales note: champion = head of platform (Elena Park). Budget cycles align with Apr 2026 procurement.
- Short open items: exact SLA for streaming, example rate-limit headers, guidance on model rollback strategy.
